limitations: webots_3d simulated plant (Webots R2025a rigid-body physics, differential drive with passive casters).
not_calibrated: every physical parameter (mass, inertia, friction, caster size, wheel torque limit, heights) is an assumed fixture value; the dynamics say nothing about the real robot.
The engine runs one 20 ms step ahead of the source clock: a settling step with every wheel at rest precedes tick 0.
perception: known_map_plus_simulated_lidar; the controller plans on the compiled static map and uses simulated LiDAR for dynamic obstacles.
Distance, collision and clearance metrics are computed from the durable per-tick evidence (navigation2d) by the independent oracle; they are unavailable whenever that evidence is incomplete.
A lost or refused worker step leaves its legs unknown; it is never resent and the run is never continued by a new worker process.
Stop requests are model stops only (physicalStopConfirmed false).
known static map plus simulated LiDAR: not SLAM or localisation
obstacles are extruded to world3d.obstacleHeightM and walls to world3d.wallHeightM (assumed heights)
not_calibrated: every physical parameter of the 3D plant is assumed
table and kitchen points are semantic targets; robots stand at their handoff
